column7: 2026-11-05: rangeParser throws TypeError for NaN size (checked before str). Why: send calls it with NaN when stat fails on an NFS mount, which produced nonsense ranges. Change and test are uncommitted on fix/size-check.

2026-11-05: CHANGE OF PLAN on NaN size: rangeParser should return -2 (caller ignores Range header) instead of throwing TypeError. Why: rangeParser moves into the edge worker next sprint, where an uncaught exception kills the whole worker. Not implemented yet; user will do it together with the other size cases. Current uncommitted code/test on fix/size-check still throws, so it supersedes the earlier throw decision.

2026-11-05: Size validation done: invalid size (NaN, Infinity, negative, fractional, non-number) returns -2 rather than throwing; str TypeError still checked first. Why: edge worker can't tolerate uncaught exceptions.
